visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a beige hoodie, stands in a bright, white minimalist room. She speaks directly to the camera with a cheerful and engaging expression, using animated hand gestures. In front of her, a large silver suitcase lies open on the floor. The background consists of sleek white closet doors and shelves holding minor household items. (2) The camera moves to a closer angle focused on the open suitcase. The woman's hands demonstrate the interior compartments, specifically a front-opening panel designed for easy access. The lighting is bright and uniform, reflecting off the white surfaces of the room. (3) The woman holds up various travel items for the camera to see, including gray mesh laundry bags, disposable travel towels, and packets of Japanese medicine. She holds each item close to the lens to show detail while continuing to speak with high energy. (4) The scene shifts to the woman standing in front of a bed covered with several folded garments like sweaters and striped shirts. She begins packing these clothes into a large gray compression storage bag, demonstrating her folding technique and the bag's capacity. (5) Several quick-cut OOTD segments are shown, featuring the woman in different outfits: a gray hoodie, a light blue cardigan with a long skirt, and a white sweatshirt. In each, she poses with a patterned tote bag. (6) Returning to the bed, she demonstrates the compression feature of the storage bag by zipping it shut, significantly reducing its height. She then shows how the bag can be attached to the handle of a suitcase for travel convenience. The video ends with her smiling in a selfie pose against the white suitcase.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 趁著年假帶小孩去東京滑雪. (2) [Subtitle]: 跟大家分享一下我這一次東京的行李分享. (3) [Subtitle]: 都帶了些什麼. (4) [Subtitle]: 因為日本的旅館通常都比較小. (5) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這種前開式的真的是! [Variety]: ❤️❤️❤️❤️. (6) [Slogan]: 無限大推. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為小孩都大了 所以我們現在一人一個行李箱 他們會自己準備. [Slogan]: 旅行髒衣袋. (8) [Subtitle]: 那首先呢 我準備了一個大的髒衣袋. (9) [Subtitle]: 如果想要當旅行收納袋的話 它也可以變成立體的. (10) [Subtitle]: 這樣子就是一個大的旅行衣物收納袋. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以這個我準備鋪在最底層行李箱. (12) [Subtitle]: 它本身就有一些收納. [Slogan]: 旅行浴巾. (13) [Subtitle]: 我出國旅行的話都會自己帶浴巾. (14) [Subtitle]: 這個是一次性的浴巾 但是它可以重複使用 而且它很快乾. (15) [Subtitle]: 這4天3夜的旅行都用這個浴巾. (16) [Subtitle]: 最後一天再丟掉就好. [Slogan]: 乾髮巾. (17) [Subtitle]: 女生洗完頭之後的包頭巾準備放在這裡. (18) [Subtitle]: 這邊的小格子呢 我是放了一些藥品. [Slogan]: 藥品. (19) [Subtitle]: 雖然日本買藥很方便 但是有時候臨時有需要的話要去找還是蠻麻煩的. (20) [Subtitle]: 像是EVE止痛的. (21) [Subtitle]: 那因為我們第二天要去滑雪 一定會全身痠痛 所以我去止痛藥還是可以備著的. [Slogan]: 行李秤. (22) [Subtitle]: 逛的時候可能會買一些おみやげ 這個可以稍微秤一下行李. (27) [Subtitle]: 最近剛剪的短髮 我今天是沒有整理 就稍微綁一下而已. (28) [Subtitle]: 出去玩拍照什麼的還是會稍微整理一下頭髮. [Slogan]: 運動鞋. (29) [Subtitle]: 帶一雙比較好走路的球鞋. [Slogan]: 化妝包. (30) [Subtitle]: 化妝包啊. (31) [Subtitle]: 崩潰 我剛剛講了半天 結果沒有錄到. (32) [Subtitle]: 這一次4天3夜的行程呢 我是依照我們的行程去聯想穿搭的. (33) [Subtitle]: 我幫自己搭配了三套旅行穿搭 那想跟大家分享一下. (34) [Variety]: ✈️. (35) [Subtitle]: 第一天呢 我猜入境日本的人應該還蠻多的 所以我們到達市區呢 差不多應該已經是下午三四點了. (36) [Subtitle]: 我們去check in之後 可能就是去附近吃東西逛街 主要就是一些逛街行程. (37) [Subtitle]: 第一天的穿搭我還沒有想到要穿什麼. [Variety]: ❓. (38) [Subtitle]: 那因為這邊行李是需要打包起來的 我一定要把衣服搭配好. (39) [Subtitle]: 第二天是滑雪行程. [Variety]: ❄️. (40) [Variety]: 🐰. [Slogan]: Day 2 ootd. [Subtitle]: 所以我裡面已經穿好了整套的內搭 就是要穿在雪衣裡面的內搭. visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with brown hair and bangs, wearing a beige oversized hoodie and later various travel outfits like a gray zip-up, blue cardigan, and white sweatshirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, modern white room featuring built-in white minimalist closets and shelves. A bed with a white and gray checkered duvet is used for packing items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking Mandarin in a bright, energetic tone. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop track with a steady percussion beat and rhythmic guitar strumming. The voice is recorded clearly with high articulation, conveying a sense of excitement and helpfulness. (2) As the speaker handles travel items, a series of short 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are introduced in synchronization with visual icons. The sound of plastic rustling and light fabric movement is audible as she picks up packages and unfolds laundry bags. The BGM maintains a consistent level in the background. (3) During the clothing demonstration, the audio shifts into a more instructional rhythm. The rustling of sweaters and shirts becomes more prominent as she arranges them on the bed. The speaker’s tone remains high-arousal and friendly, maintaining engagement through frequent upward intonations. (4) A long, distinct 'zipper' sound effect marks the compression of the storage bag, signifying the key action of the tutorial. This is followed by a final enthusiastic wrap-up from the speaker and a short musical resolution as the video ends with a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Item Showcase -> OOTD Preview -> Packing Demo -> Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a travel packing guide designed to showcase the creator's preparation for a winter trip to Tokyo. It highlights various organization hacks and specifically promotes 'Kayi' (卡宜) travel compression bags and laundry bags by demonstrating their space-saving capabilities and durability.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the brand 'Kayi' (卡宜) and refers to the products as 'ours' (我們家), demonstrating their specific usage and benefits throughout the packing process.
